notes: «عن أبيه، سعيد بن علاقة» is one link: «أبيه» with a following name is the name alone (rule 7)
«عن أبيه» after Ali b. Muhammad b. Bandar is a bare relation
Amir al-Mu'minin speaks inside the scene that Hasan al-Basri relates; he is in the saying, and Hasan is the last link
«رضي الله عنه» is a blessing and «في مسجد الكوفة» a place: neither is a link
